Tower of Hanoi Rules

A tower of discs, the smallest on top, stands on the left rod. Move it to the right rod.

The rules

A move
Tap a rod: you pick up its top disc (the rod gets a thick frame). Tap a rod to put the disc on. Tap the same rod again to put it back.
The rule
Only the top disc of a rod can move, and it may never lie on a smaller disc. Such a move is refused and nothing moves.
The goal
The whole tower on the right rod (marked with a star). The fewest moves are 2 to the power of the number of discs, minus 1: 7 with 3 discs, 15 with 4, 255 with 8.
Undo and hint
Undo takes back moves. The hint gives two rods a double frame: move the top disc from the first to the second - it is the next move of a shortest way from the position you are in.
